title: 第12章 重考第13章 挑战血脉
content_zh:
第十二章 重考
柯莉丝汀声音连连提高，一双美丽赛过蓝宝石的眸子眨动着不敢相信的目光，乾劲的实战能力没人会对他有丝毫的怀疑，但如果说到蛮力，蛮牛鲁迪一年级蛮力第三，就是二年级的很多战士在他面前也不得不低头认输，乾劲掰腕子用两只手估计还能赢鲁迪，但如果一对一，这应该必败无疑。
罗林看着柯莉丝汀那不相信的神情，心中得意再添几分，胖胖的身躯挺的笔直，鼻孔都有些朝天的对着，双手掐腰乐道：“那是当然，除了蛮牛鲁迪还能有谁？而且是连赢三次，绝不是什么侥幸！怎么样，厉害吧？”
柯莉丝汀一双美目闪出异样的光彩，齐齐飘向眼角一旁，瞅着乾劲的宿舍眉头，抬手托起下巴：“蛮力胜过鲁迪？难道他一直在隐藏实力？如果真是这样，恐怕他对四海英雄会的替补名额没有兴趣，那就是在伪装了，想要麻痹大家的烟雾……”
“帽子一定要藏好才行，一定要藏好！如果我今天身体一切的古怪全部是来自这顶帽子，那么我的未来就算找不到藏宝图中的秘宝斗技宝典，也可能有巨大的改变机会。”
乾劲躺在床底，利用几条撕坏的床单布条，将帽子稳稳的绑在床板下方，从床下爬出将床铺好好整理一番，做完全看不出哪里奇怪之后，拍干净身上的尘土快速走出房间。
战士的脾气大部分都偏为火爆刚直，罗德里格斯老师更是战士的典型性格，乾劲可不想让老师等太久而遭到惩罚，耽误了自己更多研究得到帽子的时间。
长廊的人群还没有散去，乾劲抬头看着不远处并没有离开的柯莉丝汀，发现这位班花的面上凝聚着更多的疑惑，眉宇间还带着浓郁的挑战气息味道。
“不会吧？又要挑战？”
乾劲暗暗怪叫一声，把头滴着只是盯脚下的路，快速走过柯莉丝汀的身旁。
“乾劲！”柯莉丝汀盯着乾劲的后背突然高声再次发问：“你真的对四海英雄会的替补名额没有兴趣？”
“没兴趣！”乾劲用力的挥动着手臂，脚步再次加快数分，嘴里嘀咕着：“现在的实力，就算拿到替补名额，真有机会上去，那也是丢人战败的下场。要那玩意干什么？替补？丢不起那人！我要做就做正选！”
正选？柯莉丝汀从来都未自己超乎常人的听觉感到自豪，这一刻隐约听到乾劲口中小声嘀咕的话语，首次怀疑是不是自己的听觉出了什么问题，一年级竟然有这样大的口气？要做就做正选？那可是二年级跟三年级战士跟魔法师们，才有资格争夺的名额啊。不过听他的口气，好像很了解四海英雄会的样子。
乾劲心中想着帽子的事情，走路速度比平日快了很多，在学校的宿舍几个转悠，来到了战士系的老师宿舍。
罗德里格斯的门牌很快找到，乾劲上前稳定了一下情绪，上次试炼结果被帽子砸晕的事情，对于一名战士学员竟然能够躲开来说，实在是有够丢人的一件事情。
乾劲轻轻敲响房门，屋中传出略带粗犷豪放的回音：“进来。”
乾劲认得这声音是罗德里格斯老师发出的，推门走入房间，经过有些杂乱充满着男人味道摆设的床铺，来到桌前凳子上坐着的罗德里格斯老师面前。
身为战士，罗德里格斯的个头有些矮小，身材也有些消瘦，学校中却没有人不得不承认，这位战士老师的本身实力虽然不好，但教课水平却比很多实力更强的战士老师要好很多，正应了那句‘会练的不见得会教，会教的不见得会练’。
罗德里格斯抬眼看了看自己这名最看好的得意学生，鼻孔喷出一声带有苦涩笑味的叹气，这乾劲明明有着争夺级部战士前三实力，成为四海英雄会这届的替补名额的资格，却偏偏是十人中对这事情最没有积极性的人。
为了能够想办法让乾劲至少有资格拿到观摩名额，希望在四海英雄会的观摩时间激发他的欲望，为他成为二年级战士争夺正选名额做准备，却没想到试炼考试刚开始，竟然运气差的被飞来的一顶帽子给砸晕，以此形式退出了试炼考试。

乾劲看到罗德里格斯眼中的笑意，唇角挂着三分苦涩的叹气挠头：“老师，您叫我来，不会是为了嘲笑我的吧？”
罗德里格斯眼睛瞟了眼距离不远处的一把椅子，乾劲随手一把拽到身边，屁股老实不客气的坐下说道：“谢谢老师。”
罗德里格斯看到乾劲只需要一个眼神就能明白意思，面上露出了些许的微笑，善于观察是这学生最大的特点之一，如果就因为被帽子给砸晕过去，就点背的退出这次观摩，那实在是太亏了。
沉默了数秒，罗德里格斯开腔问道：“上次的试炼考核，我跟教务处长求情半天也没给你求下重考的机会。”
“重考？”乾劲一愣，顿时明白了罗德里格斯的想法。
教务处长那圆滚滚的身材形象，快速的在乾劲脑海中划过，同时还有凯萨斯鼻青脸肿的样子也同时飞速划过。
当日凯萨斯在交流切磋中被揍的鼻青脸肿，教务处长为此发了好大一通怒火，这到不是教务处长爱护学生的身体，而是因为凯萨斯是教务处长的侄子，也是因为这名教务处长凯勒的关系，凯萨斯才敢在学校中拉帮结伙欺压同级学员。
如果不是奥克兰战士与魔法学院，只有校长对学生有开除权跟处理权，乾劲那次打完凯萨斯早就被凯勒教务处长给踢出学校了。

content_en:
Chapter 12 Retake the exam
Christine's voice kept rising, and a pair of eyes that were more beautiful than sapphire blinked in disbelief. No one would have any doubts about his actual combat ability. But when it comes to brute strength, Rudy the Bull was third in first-year strength. Even many second-year warriors had to bow their heads and admit defeat in front of him. He might still be able to beat Rudy with two hands, but if one-on-one, he would definitely lose.
Luo Lin looked at Christine's disbelieving look, and felt a little more proud. His fat body was straight, and his nostrils were pointing upwards. He pinched his waist with his hands and said happily: "Of course, who else can it be besides Rudy the Bull? And winning three times in a row is definitely not a fluke! How about it, is it awesome?"
Kristine's beautiful eyes flashed with strange brilliance. They floated to the corner of her eyes, looking at the energetic brows in the dormitory, and raised her chin with her hand: "Brute force is better than Rudy? Could it be that he has been hiding his strength? If this is the case, I am afraid that he is not interested in the substitute spot in the Heroes of the World, so he is just pretending, trying to numb everyone..."
"The hat must be hidden well, it must be hidden well! If all the weirdness in my body today comes from this hat, then even if I can't find the secret treasure fighting skills book in the treasure map, there may be huge opportunities for change in my future."
Ganjin lay at the bottom of the bed and used a few torn sheets to tie his hat firmly under the bed board. He crawled out from under the bed and tidied the bed. After making sure nothing was strange, he dusted himself off and walked out of the room quickly.
Most warriors tend to have fiery and upright temperaments, and Mr. Rodriguez is a typical warrior character. He is so motivated that he does not want his teacher to wait too long and be punished, which will delay his time to research more and get hats.
The crowd in the corridor had not dispersed yet. Ganjin looked up at Kristine who had not left not far away, and found that the class beauty had more doubts on her face, and there was a strong aura of challenge between her eyebrows.
"No? Are you going to challenge again?"
Ganjin let out a strange cry secretly, wet his head and just stared at the road under his feet, quickly walking past Christine.
"Geng Jin!" Christine stared at Gan Jin's back and suddenly asked loudly again: "Are you really not interested in the substitute spot in the Heroes of the Four Seas Association?"
"Not interested!" He waved his arms vigorously, and sped up his pace again. He muttered: "With my current strength, even if I get a substitute spot, if I really have a chance to go up, it will be an embarrassing defeat. Why do you want that thing? Substitute? I can't afford to lose that person! If I want to do it, I will be the main candidate!"
Main choice? Christine had never been proud of her extraordinary hearing. At this moment, she vaguely heard the words whispered in Gan Jin's mouth. For the first time, she wondered if there was something wrong with her hearing. How could a first grader have such a loud tone? If you want to do it, just make the right choice? Those are the places that only second-year and third-year warriors and magicians are eligible to compete for. But from his tone, he seemed to know what the Heroes of the Four Seas Association was like.
Ganjin was thinking about the hat and walked much faster than usual. He walked around the school dormitory for a few times and came to the teacher's dormitory of the warrior department.
Rodriguez's house number was found quickly, and he stepped forward to calm his mood. The fact that he was knocked unconscious by a hat during the last trial was really embarrassing for a warrior student to be able to avoid it.
Gan Jin gently knocked on the door, and a slightly rough and bold echo came from the room: "Come in."
Ganjin recognized the voice as coming from Teacher Rodriguez. He pushed the door open and walked into the room. He passed by the messy bed filled with masculine furnishings and came to Teacher Rodriguez who was sitting on the stool in front of the table.
As a warrior, Rodriguez was a bit short and thin, but no one in the school had to admit it., although this warrior teacher's own strength is not good, his teaching level is much better than that of many stronger warrior teachers. It is in line with the saying, 'Those who can practice may not necessarily be able to teach, and those who can teach may not be able to practice'.
Rodriguez looked up at his most promising student, and exhaled a bitter smile from his nostrils. This motivation clearly qualified him to compete for the top three warriors in the division and become a substitute for this session of the Heroes of the Four Seas Association, but he was the least motivated person among the ten people to do this.
In order to find a way to at least qualify Ganjin for an observation spot, he hoped that the observation time in the Heroes of the Four Seas Association would stimulate his desire and prepare him to become a second-year warrior and compete for the main selection spot. However, he did not expect that at the beginning of the trial examination, he was unlucky enough to be knocked unconscious by a flying hat, and he withdrew from the trial examination in this way.
Ganjin saw the smile in Rodriguez's eyes, and scratched his head with a bitter sigh: "Teacher, you asked me here, didn't you just want to laugh at me?"
Rodriguez glanced at a chair not far away, then Ganjin easily pulled it to him, sat down and said politely, "Thank you, teacher."
Rodriguez saw that he could understand the motivation with just one look, and a slight smile appeared on his face. Being good at observation is one of this student's biggest characteristics. It would be a real loss if he just quit the observation because he was knocked unconscious by the hat.
After being silent for a few seconds, Rodriguez spoke up and asked: "In the last trial and assessment, I begged the Dean of Academic Affairs for a long time but still didn't give you a chance to retake the exam."
"Retake the exam?" Gan Jin was stunned and immediately understood what Rodriguez was thinking.
The image of the round figure of the Dean of Academic Affairs flashed through Gan Jin's mind quickly, and at the same time, the image of Kesas with a bruised nose and face also flashed across his mind at the same time.
That day, Caesars was beaten up and his face was bruised and swollen during the exchange and discussion. The Dean of Academic Affairs was very angry about this. This was not because the Dean of Academic Affairs cared about the students' bodies, but because Caesars was the nephew of the Dean of Academic Affairs. It was also because of the relationship between the Dean of Academic Affairs, Keller, that Caesars dared to form gangs in the school to bully students of the same level.
If it weren't for the Oakland Academy of Warriors and Magic, only the principal has the power to expel and deal with students. Ganjin would have been kicked out of the school by Dean Keller after he beat Caesars that time.
